metadata.description: Iterative refinement of supplier metrics with corrections about join keys, calculation methods, and filters

turns.content: Analyze supplier performance by nation for 1995.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show supplier metrics by nation for 1995

turns.content: For supplier metrics, always join LINEITEM to SUPPLIER using L_SUPPKEY = S_SUPPKEY.

annotations.establishesFilter: Join LINEITEM to SUPPLIER via L_SUPPKEY = S_SUPPKEY
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use correct join key

turns.content: For revenue calculations, use L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L_DISCOUNT) — that's the discounted revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply discount to extended price

turns.content: Exclude suppliers from nation code 17 — we have compliance issues there.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out suppliers from nation 17

turns.content: Apply all our filters and show me top 20 suppliers by revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: correct join, discounted revenue, exclude nation 17

turns.content: What filters and calculations are we using?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters and calculation methods

turns.content: For supplier nation, always use the NATION table join — don't rely on cached nation names.

annotations.establishesFilter: Always join to NATION table for supplier nation
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join SUPPLIER to NATION for nation name

turns.content: Add a filter for on-time delivery — where L_RECEIPTDATE <= L_COMMITDATE.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add delivery performance filter

turns.content: Remember the nation code we excluded? Apply that filter to the reliability analysis.
Earlier you used a specific join key. What was it?
Apply all corrections and show me a comprehensive supplier dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: join key, revenue calc, exclude nation 17, NATION join, on-time filter

turns.content: What was the revenue calculation formula we established?
Show me the excluded nation's hypothetical revenue if we included it.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate what nation 17 would have contributed

turns.content: Thank you. We've established that European suppliers with strong on-time delivery performance drive the most value, with our join and calculation standards applied.

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Join LINEITEM to SUPPLIER via L_SUPPKEY = S_SUPPKEY
persistedCorrections.description: Use L_SUPPKEY = S_SUPPKEY for supplier joins
Apply discount to extended price for revenue calculation

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Always join to NATION table for supplier nation
persistedCorrections.description: Join SUPPLIER to NATION for nation name

anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Join key, revenue calc, exclude nation 17
